abstract: Incubate. Check. Wash. Detach. Neutralise. Count. Seed. Discard. Repeat. Cell culture is a staple of biological research, but its repetitive, time-intensive nature can limit scientists' capacity. We explore how researchers at the Wellcome Sanger Institute are investigating automation to streamline this process and accelerate genomic research.
